mapper.update: INSERT INTO BUYER_STOCK_LIST /* 구매사 수불 상세내역 */ ( BUYER , WAREHOUSE_CODE , JOB_TYPE , JOB_NO , ITEM_NO , ITEM_QTY , JOB_DATE , JOB_TIME , JOB_NOTE , CREATE_USER_ID , CREATE_DEPT_CD , JOB_USER_ID , JOB_DEPT_CD , GR_NO , GR_SEQ , STATUS ) VALUES ( #{st_com_code} , 'W' , 'JO' , TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD') || TO_CHAR(F_BUYER_SQMT(#{st_com_code},'JO'),'FM0000') , #{st_item_no} , #{st_chul_qty} , TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD') , TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'HH24MISS') , #{st_remark} , #{st_user_id} , #{st_user_dept} , #{st_user_id} , #{st_user_dept} , '' , '' , 'C' )

MERGE INTO BUYER_STOCK /* 구매사 재고 관리 테이블 */ USING DUAL ON ( BUYER = #{st_com_code} AND WAREHOUSE_CODE = 'W' AND ITEM_NO = #{st_item_no} ) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET TOT_QTY = TOT_QTY - #{st_chul_qty} , AVAIL_QTY = AVAIL_QTY - #{st_chul_qty} , CHANGE_DATE = SYSDATE WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( BUYER , WAREHOUSE_CODE , ITEM_NO , STATUS , TOT_QTY , ALLOC_QTY , AVAIL_QTY , PRE_GR_QTY , CREATE_DATE , CHANGE_DATE ) VALUES ( #{st_com_code} , 'W' , #{st_item_no} , 'C' , #{st_chul_qty} , 0 , #{st_chul_qty} , 0 , SYSDATE , SYSDATE )
